definition: what I can do at each whole number of my safety level

settled:
Each whole number is a rung with an anchor on it, and half steps interpolate between them.

Zero is tolerating existing. One is being able to rest: reading fiction, watching shows, playing games. Two is being able to be productive: programming, projects, chores. Three is being able to feel happiness: being social, nature, food, music, anything aesthetic. Four is being able to be vulnerable: conflict, singing, dancing, being perceived. Five is being able to be outgoing: starting conversations, paying active attention to someone, caring about them.

The ladder is not a measure of how much incoming stress I can take. Each rung pushes my output one step further from the floor. Tolerate, absorb, produce, enjoy, expose, extend.

Handling someone else's distress without flooding comes in around five. Below that rung I bridge it with trained scripts, which carry the caring behaviour without needing the margin.

title: The Rungs Of My Safety Scale
